exhibition.collection.intro:
**Have you already been at [Themes](#/themes) to do a tour through the exhibition?**

As a second approach, this might be the best choice to explore the exhibition database. A range of filters allows you to choose what you want to see.

For research, you can use the search\* bar, located on the top right of the page. If you are interested in learning about contributions from a specific institution, the [**Partner**](#/partners) section would be the best place to start, while [**My Collection**](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php) lets you add any item from this project to your personal collection.

\*Please be aware that the search tool covers only the artefacts in this exhibition. If you wish to carry out a search in the overall MWNF Database, please [click here](https://www.museumwnf.org/database_searchform.php) or go to the above-mentioned projects to search their databases.

exhibition.partners.intro:
**Have you already been at [Themes](#/themes) to do a tour through the exhibition?**

If you are interested in learning about the contribution from a specific institution, this page might be the best place to start. The list distinguishes between Partners that have contributed specifically to the exhibition, and Partners that are represented by exhibition-related material contributed to other MWNF projects. For this reason, some Partners are listed twice or more.

exhibition.timeline.intro:
**Have you already been at [Themes](#/themes) to do a tour through the Exhibition?**

Here you will find information about historical events related to the topics of the Exhibition.

Currently, this page is a work-in-progress and the data entered are provisional.

We are doing our best to complete the Exhibition Timeline as soon as possible. If you are willing to contribute, please contact us at [office@museumwnf.net](mailto:office@museumwnf.net).
